title: Diagnose 1: the boundary crash
prompt: Classify the error (which taxonomy class?), then repair `lastChar` so it returns the LAST character's char code. Empty input is not part of this task's contract (s is non-empty).

tests.name: repaired boundary
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq((char) Solution.lastChar("abc"), 'c', "last char code");
CjTestBase.checkEq((char) Solution.lastChar("z"), 'z', "single char");
tests.hint: Class 1/6 (index off-by-one): length() is one past the end; use length() - 1.
